svg.title: SK Arif Hossain
svg.desc: I build the whole path: firmware on the board, the cloud in between, the app in your hand. A signal travels along a circuit trace from an ESP32 pad to Firebase to a web and Android pad.
svg.text: I build the whole path: firmware on the board, the cloud in between,
and the app in your hand.
B.Tech IT 2027, IoT intern at Maxbridge Solutions, Kolkata
